newsitem.title: UK: Courts to split 2 shares into 5 10p shrs.
newsitem.headline: Courts to split 2 shares into 5 10p shrs.

text.p: British furniture retailer Courts Plc said on Thursday it was planning to allot five new ordinary shares of 10 pence each in lieu to every two ordinary shares of 25 pence currently held.
In a statement, the company said it was doing this to improve the marketability of the shares which closed on Wednesday at 1,160 pence.
The company would seek shareholder approval on the split in an extraordinary general meeting on January 8, 1997.
The interim dividend payable on each share would be one pence for every new share.
The company had announced a higher pretax profit of 9.6 million stg on Thursday and offered a dividend of 2.5 pence on each of its existing, pre-split shares.
